summary: Tested Head Out destination search Google Places (New) autocomplete pilot (provider seam + OSM fallback), feature-flagged default OFF. All 4 scenarios PASS: (1) default-off regression — zero behavior change, no dropdown while typing, manual Search button + /api/geocode/search flow identical to before; (2) both flags ON — new debounced dropdown (dp-places-suggestions) appears after typing 3+ chars with ~300ms debounce, Google call fails (invalid-format key) and automatically falls back to OSM provider as designed, tapping a suggestion fills input and recenters map pin; (3) fail-closed — frontend flag ON + backend flag OFF (503) produces no crash, no error dropdown, manual search flow fully intact; (4) backend direct checks via pytest (4/4 passed) confirm /api/geo/autocomplete returns 503 with correct detail when off, 200 with provider:osm suggestions when on, /api/geo/details resolves correctly, and /api/geocode/search is completely unaffected in both states. Both flags were reverted to false (required shipped default) and both services restarted/verified at the end of testing.

minor.issue: India bias (regionCode:IN) is only applied to the GooglePlacesProvider request payload; NominatimFallbackProvider.autocomplete() has no equivalent bias param, so once Google fails and OSM fallback kicks in (the only reachable path given the current non-functional key), results skew toward whichever country matches alphabetically/globally first (e.g. typing 'Mum' surfaced 'Miami University Middletown' in Ohio, USA, ahead of any Indian 'Mumbai' result). Not a blocking bug per the task's explicit acceptance criteria (OSM fallback suggestions appearing = PASS), but worth noting since the product decision was 'bias towards India but allow global' and that bias is currently lost whenever the fallback path is exercised.

action_items: Optional/low priority: consider passing an India-bias hint (e.g. viewbox/countrycodes=in with no hard filter, matching the 'allow global' requirement) into NominatimFallbackProvider's Nominatim query so the OSM-fallback path keeps the same India-first bias intent as the Google path, since OSM fallback is the path that actually executes today given the placeholder key.
critical_code_review_comments: geo_router.py cleanly implements the provider seam (GeoProvider Protocol, GooglePlacesProvider, NominatimFallbackProvider) with sensible fail-closed semantics (503 when flag/key missing, automatic same-request fallback to OSM on Google error) — well structured and consistent with geocode_router.py's existing patterns (shared rate limiting/caching approach, User-Agent compliance).

DestinationPicker.tsx correctly gates all new behavior behind PLACES_AUTOCOMPLETE_ENABLED at module load time, and every new async path (fetchPlacesAutocomplete, fetchPlaceDetails) throws on non-2xx so the catch blocks fail closed to 'no dropdown' without touching the pre-existing manual search state — verified this holds true live, not just by code reading.
Session token lifecycle (new UUID on first keystroke of a fresh search, discarded after details lookup) is implemented correctly per Places billing semantics.
